story_text:
## What is Beat Root ?
A handcrafted French steel tongue drum with six moods in one. Play real melodies in minutes — no experience, no wrong notes.
We're really proud to bring this one back. Beat Root is a steel tongue drum we design and build by hand in France. Rest it on your lap, let your hands fall, and out comes a melody that's already in tune — within minutes, with no experience at all. No theory, no lessons, no wrong note possible.
What makes it special: it holds six different moods, and you switch between them in seconds. Beat Root adapts to where you are — calm one minute, bright and rhythmic the next.
Today we're relaunching production on Kickstarter, and we'd love you with us for this next chapter.
## Just play it. You already know it.
This is the whole idea: you already know how to play it. Every note is tuned to harmonize with the others, so whatever you play sounds right. Close your eyes, follow your hand, and you're making music almost immediately. No wrong note is possible — and that one fact opens the door to everyone, musician or not.
## Rest it on your lap, and it answers like a friend
Put it on your knees and you don't just hear it — you feel it. Each note vibrates gently against you, an instant little reward. A few minutes in, the room feels softer, and so do you.
## Hands, mallets, or both
Bare hands for a soft, organic touch; the included mallets for a clearer, brighter tone; or one of each, to find your own way.
## Made for your everyday moments
People reach for Beat Root at all the small turning points of a day — a few minutes in the morning to set the tone, a creative break between tasks, an evening to let the day go, a calm moment at home. It asks nothing of you but to play.
## Six moods, one instrument — with a little Beat Root twist
Most tongue drums are locked to a single scale. Ours isn't. Beat Root carries six scales, each with its own mood — and we built a clever little system so you can switch between them in seconds.
- 🌞 Happy — Joy. Bright, open, optimistic. The easiest place to start.
- 🧘 Zen — Calm. Deep relaxation and quiet (our favorite).
- 🔥 Tribal — Energy. Exotic, alive, with rhythms that take off.
- 🌙 Melancholia — Depth. Gentle and introspective; lovely behind a voice or a guitar.
- ✨ Space — Expansion. Cinematic and weightless.
- 🌿 Nature — Balance. Contemplative: forests, water, open air.
Six scales, six feelings. Choose the sound that fits the moment.
## Change the mood in seconds
Inside the drum: a small chart, three magnets, five colored stickers. Move the magnets where the chart shows, and you go from calm to energy, from depth to joy — no tools, no fuss, in a few seconds.
## More than a decade in the making
During a festival in 2012, Julien Puget — a percussionist for over twenty years — laid hands on his first steel tongue drum. Love at first touch. He started making his own from gas bottles, but every bottle sounded different, so no two instruments were ever the same.
He didn't give up. A year of work and dozens of prototypes later, he found a process that finally guaranteed a stable, repeatable sound. In 2014, the first batch of 30 Beat Root drums came to life — already through a crowdfunding campaign. (Beat Root was born on crowdfunding. Today the circle closes.)
- MusikMesse 2014 (Frankfurt) — international distributors take notice.
- 2015 — our electro-acoustic model launches; Yamaha becomes our sole distributor in Japan; Audiofanzine awards us its 2015 "Solid Value" distinction.
- 2018: six scales in one drum. 2020: the 432 Hz version for wellness and relaxation practitioners.
Every Beat Root is handcrafted in France, with obsessive care for tuning, resonance and sustain — the French touch, and a lot of heart. ❤️
## What it gives back
The words we treasure most don't come from the press. They come from living rooms.
People tell us the same thing, over and over:
- A few quiet minutes a day that simply feel good.
- Real melodies — from people who were sure they never could.
- An evening with the kids. A quiet moment alone. A memory the family keeps.
The reason is always the same: no wrong note, nothing to fear — only something to feel.
## Availability & rewards
Every Beat Root comes with a pair of mallets and is available in four finishes, to choose with any reward: All-Black, All-White, Black, White.
You can also customize it with two options, available on any reward:
- 432 Hz tuning · +30€: by default, each Beat Root is tuned to the standard 440Hz. For 30€ more, you can choose 432Hz instead.
- Carrying bag · +39€: to protect your Beat Root and take it anywhere.
Once the campaign ends, the public retail price will be $526 (478€) for a 440Hz Beat Root and $576 (518€) for a 432Hz Beat Root.
- The First Circle — Super Early Bird · 349€ (432Hz: 379€) · limited to 30 (a nod to the 30 of 2014)
One Beat Root (color of choice: All-Black / All-White / Black / White) · mallets included · the best price of the campaign.
- Early Bird · 379€ (432Hz: 409€) · limited to 60 — one Beat Root, color of choice + mallets.
- Beat Root — Kickstarter price · 399€ (432Hz: 429€) — one Beat Root, color of choice + mallets.
- 2x Beat Root · 720€ (both tuned to 432Hz: 780€) — Two Beat Root, each in the finish of your choice, to play together or gift.
- Duo Beat Root & 432Hz Beat Root · 750€ — One 440Hz Beat Root and one 432Hz Beat Root, each in the finish of your choice.

## Kind words & the Beat Root Family
- 🏆 Audiofanzine "Solid Value" Award 2015 — Drums & Percussion.
- 🇯🇵 Trusted by Yamaha as its sole distributor in Japan.
🎶 The Beat Root Family is a community of artists who've made the instrument part of their own music. The range says it all — from deep relaxation to a beatbox world champion's live rig ✨
## Features
- Six scales in one — Happy, Zen, Tribal, Melancholia, Space, Nature — switchable in seconds via our magnet system.
- Tuning: standard, or fully 432 Hz (your choice).
- Electro-acoustic: built-in microphone + 1/4" jack output.
- Finish: matte, with a carbon-effect band.
- Colors: All-Black · All-White · Black · White.
- In the box: the instrument + quick-start guide + mallets.
- Warranty: 2 years. Made in France.
## Sound & connectivity
Beat Root isn't only acoustic. The built-in microphone and jack output let you record your melodies straight into a track, plug into an amp or speaker to fill a larger room, or run the sound through your favorite effects. We chose the steel itself for its acoustic properties — precisely so it captures that tone faithfully. An intimate instrument that's also ready for the stage and the studio.
## Dimensions & weight
- Size: 11.8 × 11.8 × 6.7 in (30 × 30 × 17 cm)
- Weight: ~11 lbs (~5 kg)
- Compact enough to live on a table, a lap, or travel in its case.
## Why we're on Kickstarter
We'll be honest with you. We chose the slow path — an instrument designed, tuned and finished by hand in France to reach real depth and clarity, rather than a mass-produced one. We stand by that choice, but it also means we can't move at a factory's pace, and our production has, for now, come to a pause.
We've been through a hard stretch. The market has been flooded with mass-produced, low-cost tongue drums, often made in China. Their price is unbeatable — but the depth, the clarity of the notes and the harmonic richness are nothing like an instrument that's thought through, tuned and finished by hand to chase sonic perfection. The true value of these instruments got lost — and our production ground to a halt (all our models and colors are currently out of stock)
This campaign has one simple, honest goal: to restart a new production run of Beat Root and rebuild on solid ground, with you beside us. It's one of the most personal things we've ever done — real potential, and real risk — which is exactly why Kickstarter is the right place to restart it (pun intended).
By backing us, you're helping a French craft adventure, begun in 2012, rise from its ashes. The world needs beautiful frequencies — and we've seen, first-hand, the impact this instrument can have on a life.
## Timeline & shipping
- Campaign ends: December 31, 2026.
- Production: starts the moment we're funded.
- Delivery: The first batch of 300 Beat Root is expected to ship in April 2027. If demand exceeds this number, we plan to ship a second batch (up to 300 Beat Root) in June 2027.
- Shipping : Shipping isn’t included in your pledge. We’ll collect shipping later through the Pledge Manager when we’re getting ready to ship.
This allows us to lock in the best possible rates closer to delivery.
We’re actively working with our logistics partners to bring these costs down as much as possible.
- Taxes & Duties : Depending on your country, taxes or duties may apply. We work with regional import partners and handle the whole process so you don’t have to deal with customs yourself.
The exact amount will be calculated based on your country and collected through the Pledge Manager before we ship. That means you’ll see the full cost in advance, and nothing unexpected should show up when your Beat Root arrives.
- After that: the community space (below).
## What we'll build next, together
If we pass our goal, we'll finally build the idea closest to our hearts: a community space for sharing music. A place where every Beat Root owner can share their creations, find beautiful melodies to play in minutes, and learn through a simple, friendly tablature system open to everyone. It would bring the whole Beat Root community together — and that, for us, would be the real reward.
## Hear it for yourself
In the end, this is an instrument and an instrument is judged by ear.
risks: We've been making Beat Root since 2012, so the product isn't the unknown here — it exists, it's proven, and we know the process inside out. The real challenge is industrial and logistical: restarting a production run means sourcing materials, scheduling the workshop, and committing to lead times we can actually keep. A sourcing or shipping delay could push a delivery back by a few weeks. If it does, we'll tell you openly and early, through our Kickstarter updates — we'd rather promise a timeline we can hold than one that just sounds nicer. Ten-plus years of experience, past partnerships (Yamaha in Japan among them), and our deep familiarity with this instrument are our best safeguards.

faq.q: Do I really need no musical experience?
faq.a: None at all. Every note is tuned to harmonize with the others, so whatever you play sounds right from the very first minute – there's simply no wrong note to hit.

faq.q: Hands or mallets – how do I play it?
faq.a: Both work beautifully. The included mallets are the easiest way to start and give a clear, deep tone; playing with your hands comes later and brings a real sense of freedom. (Avoid hard xylophone or drum mallets – they can mark the instrument)

faq.q: Is it really suited to relaxation, meditation and kids?
faq.a: Yes – that's its heart. Its soft, soothing sound is made for meditation, relaxation, music and sound therapy, and it's a wonderful first instrument for the musical awakening of children and adults alike.

faq.q: How do I switch between the six scales?
faq.a: Inside the drum you'll find three small magnets, color stickers and a diagram. Place the magnets on the colors of the scale you want – calm, bright, meditative – and you're there in a few seconds.

faq.q: Which notes does each of the six scales play?
faq.a:
All six scales are in G, so you can switch moods without losing your bearings. Here are the notes, from the lowest to the highest tongue (international notation first, then solfège):

Happy (Joy): G C D E G A B D / Sol Do Ré Mi Sol La Si Ré
Zen (Calm): G C D E♭ G A B♭ D / Sol Do Ré Mi♭ Sol La Si♭ Ré
Tribal (Energy): G B D E G A B D / Sol Si Ré Mi Sol La Si Ré
Melancholia (Depth): G C D E♭ G A B♭ C / Sol Do Ré Mi♭ Sol La Si♭ Do
Space (Expansion): G B D E♭ G A B D / Sol Si Ré Mi♭ Sol La Si Ré
Natu…

faq.q: Can I create more than six scales?
faq.a: If you like to experiment, yes. Placing a magnet under a tongue lowers that note by a semitone, so from the default G major you can reach dozens of scales. Ask us and we'll happily guide you.

faq.q: Do I need an amplifier to hear it?
faq.a: No. The deep, melodious sound comes from the instrument's own resonance chamber – play it on your lap, in a forest, anywhere. The electro-acoustic option is a bonus, never a requirement.

faq.q: What does the built-in microphone add?
faq.a: It lets you record your playing straight into a track, or amplify it through an amp, speaker or mixer via the 6.35 mm jack – great for music-making and the stage. (Headphones don't plug in directly; connect them through an amp or mixer.)

faq.q: Will it stay in tune over the years?
faq.a: Yes. The alloy we use, plus a heat treatment after tuning, keep it remarkably stable. There is no re-tuning needed even after years – and the laser-cut notes shrug off the occasional knock.

faq.q: How big and heavy is it?
faq.a: A Beat Root is about 12 in (30 cm) across and 6.7 in (17 cm) tall, ~11 lbs (5 kg) – compact enough to live on a table or your lap.

faq.q: When will I receive my Beat Root?
faq.a: Production starts as soon as we're funded. The first batch of 300 Beat Root is expected to ship in April 2027. If demand exceeds this number, we plan to ship a second batch (up to 300 Beat Root) in June 2027.

Your Beat Root arrives ready to play. Inside the box you'll find:

• Your Beat Root, in the color and tuning you chose
• A pair of mallets
• 3 magnets, all you need to switch between the six scales
• A quick-start guide to change scales and play your first notes

Unbox it, pick up the mallets, and play. No setup, no tuning required.

faq.q: Does the Kickstarter price include VAT?
faq.a: No. VAT and customs fees are not included in the Kickstarter pricing and will be the responsibility of each customer upon receiving their item in the destination country. Estimated delivery is April 2027.

faq.q: Does it come with a guarantee or warranty?
faq.a: Yes. Beat Root tongue drum includes a 2‑year warranty.

faq.q: What happens if Beat Root doesn’t reach the funding objective?
faq.a:
Nothing is charged. Kickstarter is all-or-nothing: your card is only charged if the campaign reaches its goal by the deadline. If we fall short, no money changes hands, and you owe nothing.

But we believe in this one. In 2014, 30 backers brought the very first Beat Roots to life. We're counting on you to write the next chapter with us.
